in_hebrew.name: Furiya
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Furiya הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word ‘phōrós’, meaning ‘bright’ or ‘shining’, Furiya represents the light of joy and happiness. In Christian tradition, Furiya is believed to symbolize the joy and peace that comes from a deep connection with God.
